name: Dinah (Jacob's daughter)
title: Jacob's only named daughter
summary: Dinah was the only named daughter of Jacob and Leah. She is best known for the tragic event in Shechem, where she was violated by Shechem, son of Hamor. This led to her brothers Simeon and Levi avenging her by killing all the men in the city.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Dinah
keyEvents.description: Dinah was born as the daughter of Jacob and Leah, as Leah's seventh child. She is the only one of Jacob's daughters mentioned by name in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Dinah Visits the Women of the Land
keyEvents.description: Dinah went out to see the women of the land while her family lived near the city of Shechem.

keyEvents.title: Shechem Violates Dinah
keyEvents.description: Shechem, son of the Hivite prince Hamor, saw Dinah and took her by force. Afterwards, he wanted to marry her.

keyEvents.title: Negotiations for Marriage
keyEvents.description: Hamor and Shechem came to Jacob to negotiate marriage with Dinah. Jacob's sons set the condition that all the men in Shechem must be circumcised.

keyEvents.title: Simeon and Levi Take Revenge
keyEvents.description: On the third day after the circumcision, when the men were weakest, Simeon and Levi entered the city and killed all the men, including Hamor and Shechem, and brought Dinah home.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Reaction
keyEvents.description: Jacob rebuked Simeon and Levi for their actions, as he feared revenge from the neighboring peoples. The brothers defended themselves by saying that Dinah should not be treated like a prostitute.
